dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two distinct, thick, dark horizontal bands are visible across the lower wing with moderate grayscale contrast against the medium-grey background.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Pale, thin edges on folded secondary feathers provide clear boundary sharpness against the darker feather centers.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast transverse black and white banding on the tail feathers, transitioning into a prominent white patch at the rump/tail base.
